# DCH Automotive Car Remaps Ready Reckoner

DCH Automotive is a Viezu Approved Dealer specializing in ECU remapping for fleet and commercial vehicles in the South East of England. The Car Remaps Ready Reckoner provides a searchable catalogue of over 1,500 vehicle models with performance figures, Economy Tuning gains, and real-world pricing from the Viezu platform — helping fleet operators understand exact tuning options and fuel savings potential for their specific vehicles.

## JSON API Endpoint

**URL:** `/api/car-remaps/lookup`

Query parameters (progressive refinement): `make`, `model`, `fuelType`, `variant`

This RESTful endpoint powers the interactive vehicle finder on the Car Remaps page. Supply a vehicle make, and the API returns available models; supply a model, and it returns fuel types; continue narrowing to get exact performance figures and pricing for that specific variant.

## Model Context Protocol (MCP) Integration

**Endpoint:** `/api/mcp`

DCH Automotive exposes the car remaps catalogue via the Model Context Protocol (Streamable HTTP transport), making the ready reckoner accessible to Claude agents and MCP-compatible clients. Agents can call the `lookup_vehicle_tuning` tool to query performance specs, Economy Tuning gains, and pricing programmatically — useful for building fleet efficiency reports, ROI calculators, or vehicle procurement decision support within your own tools.

See [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) for implementation details and MCP client configuration.
